integrity: Integral homology proved by coefficient-independent forest chain argument; equivariant character proved using oriented fixed cellular traces; finite tests corroborate but are not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only two unordered particles on wheels with rim length k≥5; complete rational D_k representation and rational quotient homology, no integral quotient or integral representation decomposition; bibliographic risk from unindexed equivalents or implicit prior constructions.
title: Dihedral homology of unordered two-particle wheel configurations
